Title: SPEAK UP: A Virtual Speech Training Simulator
Authors: Clyde Andre D. L. Anicete; Angelo N. Espiritu; Richard Vincent Go; Mohammed Jake O. Medallo
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
Abstract: This capstone develops a virtual speech training simulator that helps STI Ormoc students practice presentations with guided feedback and progress tracking.

Title: Smart Library Attendance Companion
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
Abstract: The study designs a companion mobile workflow that complements campus library attendance logging while keeping student identity checks under librarian supervision.

Title: Campus Lost-and-Found Web Portal
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
Abstract: This thesis proposes a lost-and-found portal for STI Ormoc that catalogs found items and notifies claimants through moderated staff review.

Title: Ormoc Eco-Tour Itinerary Planner
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Tourism Management
Abstract: The project builds an itinerary planner that recommends Ormoc eco-tourism routes with transport estimates and local partner contacts for student tour operators.

Title: Community Homestay Readiness Assessment
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Tourism Management
Abstract: This study assesses homestay readiness among selected Ormoc households and recommends training modules for guest service and safety compliance.

Title: Digital Souvenir Marketing for Local Tours
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Tourism Management
Abstract: The research evaluates digital souvenir marketing tactics for local tour packages and measures visitor purchase intent among campus visitors.

Title: Kitchen Waste Reduction in Campus Catering
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management
Abstract: This capstone measures kitchen waste in a campus catering simulation and proposes portioning and inventory controls suitable for student-run outlets.

Title: Guest Feedback Dashboard for Training Hotels
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management
Abstract: The study develops a guest feedback dashboard that helps hospitality trainees prioritize service recovery actions during practicum shifts.

Title: Event Banquet Layout Optimizer
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management
Abstract: This thesis creates a banquet layout optimizer that balances seating capacity and service aisles for school event venues in Ormoc.

Title: Mobile Menu Board for Culinary Labs
Abstract: The project introduces a mobile menu board for culinary laboratory services that updates daily specials and allergen notes for student diners.

Title: Tourism Operations Field Guide App
Abstract: This study packages a field guide application for tourism operations trainees covering site briefings and contingency checklists for Ormoc tours.

Title: Local Heritage Walk Story Map
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
Abstract: The capstone builds a story map that guides visitors through Ormoc heritage walks with multimedia stops curated by campus researchers.

Title: Sustainable Front-Office Checklists
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Hospitality Management
Abstract: This research designs sustainable front-office checklists that reduce paper use while preserving guest privacy during training hotel operations.

Title: Visitor Flow Study for Lake Danao Day Tours
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Tourism Management
Abstract: The thesis studies visitor flow at Lake Danao day tours and recommends pacing strategies that improve satisfaction without overcrowding trailheads.

Title: Inventory Alert Bot for Print Supplies Desk
Department_Or_Program: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
Abstract: This project prototypes an inventory alert bot for the library print supplies desk that notifies staff when ink and paper reach reorder thresholds.
